source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, perfectly flat surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Rugged hand-loomed tropical sailor's slop-cloth at 30 cm garment scale, woven from crisp fibrous abaca banana-hemp and unbleached sea-cotton in vertical 22 mm warp stripes alternating lighter and darker grey values, with visible slubby two-ply warp threads, breathable basket-twill interlacing, and one neat horizontal darned mend patch. Neutral mid-grey (#8a8a8a), fully desaturated: no brown, tan or warm cast; only the light and dark relief of the weave so it can be tinted to any palette colour.
